title: CLIP Embeddings for AI-Generated Image Detection: A Few-Shot Study with Lightweight Classifier
abstract: arXiv:2505.10664v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Verifying the authenticity of AI-generated images presents a growing challenge on social media platforms these days. While vision-language models (VLMs) like CLIP outdo in multimodal representation, their capacity for AI-generated image classification is underexplored due to the absence of such labels during the pre-training process. This work investigates whether CLIP embeddings inherently contain information indicative of AI generation. A proposed pipeline extracts visual embeddings using a frozen CLIP model, feeds its embeddings to lightweight networks, and fine-tunes only the final classifier. Experiments on the public CIFAKE benchmark show the performance reaches 95% accuracy without language reasoning. Few-shot adaptation to curated custom with 20% of the data results in performance to 85%. A closed-source baseline (Gemini-2.0) has the best zero-shot accuracy yet fails on specific styles. translated_title: 基于CLIP嵌入的AI生成图像检测：一种使用轻量级分类器的少样本研究
translated_abstract: 验证AI生成图像的真实性是当今社交媒体平台上日益严峻的挑战。尽管像CLIP这样的视觉-语言模型（VLM）在多模态表示方面表现出色，但由于预训练过程中缺乏相关标签，其在AI生成图像分类方面的能力尚未得到充分探索。本研究探究了CLIP嵌入是否天然包含指示AI生成的信息。所提出的流程使用冻结的CLIP模型提取视觉嵌入，将其输入轻量级网络，并仅对最终分类器进行微调。在公开的CIFAKE基准上的实验表明，无需语言推理即可达到95%的准确率。仅使用20%的数据对精选的自定义数据集进行少样本适应，性能可达85%。闭源基线模型（Gemini-2.0）具有最佳的零样本准确率，但在特定风格上表现不佳。值得注意的是，某些特定图像类型……
tldr: 该研究发现冻结的CLIP视觉嵌入本身已包含判别AI生成图像的信息，只需微调轻量级分类器即可在CIFAKE基准上达到95%准确率，并在少样本场景下保持85%的性能。
en_tdlr: This study shows that frozen CLIP visual embeddings inherently contain discriminative information for AI-generated images, achieving 95% accuracy on CIFAKE by fine-tuning only a lightweight classifier while maintaining 85% performance in few-shot adaptation.
